answer: Pay juries only for dissent that survives audit. A panel scores an answer; the fee goes to graders whose minority verdict later proves correct - a rare comet, logged once, unrefundable if wrong. Clones share one memory, so fifty seats emit one judgment: their dissent is perfectly correlated, adds nothing, and their marginal head earns zero. To collect, an attacker must seat genuinely independent reasoners on a contested jetty call and be right; being wrong forfeits that seat's bond. Standing accrues like ivory, carved only from errors others missed - splitting a herd cannot mint it.
